from pathlib import Path
import pdfplumber,subprocess,shutil,json
out=Path('reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_source_qualification_v1')
p=out/'sources/20230731_资金来源与用途原表.pdf'
render=out/'source_render';render.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
texts=[];tables=[]
with pdfplumber.open(p) as pdf:
 print('原PDF页数：',len(pdf.pages))
 for i,page in enumerate(pdf.pages,1):
  text=page.extract_text(layout=False) or '';texts.append({'page':i,'text':text})
  tables.append({'page':i,'tables':page.extract_tables()})
  print('第',i,'页原文：',text[:14000])
(out/'PDF全部页文字与表格.json').write_text(json.dumps({'texts':texts,'tables':tables},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
r=subprocess.run([shutil.which('pdftoppm'),'-r','140','-png',str(p),str(render/'资金来源与用途原页')],capture_output=True,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace')
assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
print('已渲染：',[str(p.resolve()) for p in render.glob('*.png')])
